title: stabilize-metering-anchor-on-tenant-timezone-and-reconcile-export-prorate-gaps
creator: Daniel Kim
description: Summary: A set of production incidents and postmortem analysis show invoices with dangling proration deltas and occasional negative Stripe line items tied to two correlated conditions: (1) tenant-local quota resets that cross DST boundaries or are reanchored during leader failover, and (2) export leader restarts that produce non-deterministic hourly anchor selection and duplicated prorate fragments in the Stripe/NetSuite export pipeline. This ticket standardizes the anchoring semantics to a tenant-timezone anchored UTC offset stored on subscription metadata, makes export lines idempotent with stable seqnums, and implements a reconciler/backfill plan to repair the past 30 days of affected invoices. The work spans runtime metering anchors, export generator, and reconciler fixes plus a 7-day shadow run to validate correctness before full cutover.
acceptance_criteria: All new hourly usage exports include a deterministic anchor field derived from subscription.tenant_timezone_offset and are independent of leader election ordering.
Exported invoice line generation is idempotent: each ledger delta maps to a single stable export_seq_num and duplicate generation is deduplicated by aggregator.
Shadow exports for 7 days show zero increase in negative line items vs baseline and reconcile to expected invoice totals within 0.1% for sampled tenants.
Backfill script successfully rewrites exports for 30-day window in dry-run mode and produces a reconciliation report listing corrected invoice ids and net delta per customer.
Integration tests simulate DST transitions + leader failover and assert no duplicated prorate fragments are emitted and invoice sign is preserved.
Runbook updated with steps to pause exports, kick off backfill, and rollback if net-delta > threshold for >1% of customers.
Dashboard alert (exports.proration.delta_anomaly) triggers when daily export correction exceeds threshold and has runbook links.
Post-migration audit: sample of 200 invoices across regions validated by Finance and Product with sign-off recorded in Confluence.
reproduction_steps: 1) Simulate tenant A with subscription timezone America/Los_Angeles and rapid plan swap at 2026-03-14 01:30 local (DST spring forward).
2) Force export leader failover during aggregation window by killing export-leader pod to create race between offset anchoring and aggregator commit.

3) Replay meter pulses for the hour with injected rate-limit credit events from retries; run export job and observe duplicate prorate fragments and negative line items in generated Stripe export JSON.
4) Compare ledger delta -> export_seq_num mapping across leader instances to observe non-deterministic seqnum assignment.
5) Run current reconciler; note partial fixes and residual invoice discrepancies.
decision_log: 2026-03-11: Decided to anchor to subscription.tenant_timezone_offset stored at subscription creation time rather than per-export timezone lookup to avoid drift when tenant updates tz metadata.

2026-03-12: Chose stable export_seq_num = sha256(ledger_id + epoch_hour_anchor + usage_bucket) hex prefix to create deterministic idempotency key rather than simple incremental counters which break under concurrent leaders.
2026-03-13: Agreed to run 7-day shadow exports in parallel with production exports and then gate full cutover on reconciliation metrics, rather than immediate hot swap.
2026-03-13: Finance requested a dry-run backfill report and an approval step before any re-emit of adjusted Stripe line items.
recent_updates: 2026-03-10: Ticket created after incident triage. Collected sample of 18 affected invoices from US and EU tenants.
2026-03-11: Initial prototype for deterministic seqnum generator in platform repo (WIP).
2026-03-12: Integration test harness updated to support tenant-local timezone simulation; added DST cases.
2026-03-13: Finance confirmed acceptance criteria for dry-run report format and requested timeboxed proposal for backfill runtime.
2026-03-14: Deployed export_seqnum change to staging and validated idempotency on replayed ledger data; preparing shadow export config.
blockers: Need Finance approval on dry-run backfill report format before any writes to Stripe are allowed.
Production monitoring currently lacks daily per-tenant net-delta alert threshold; SRE to add metric before cutover.
Edge case: legacy subscriptions missing timezone metadata require conservative defaulting strategy and may need manual reconciliation for historical invoices.
mitigation_plan: 1) Immediately enable conservative guardrails in export generator: disallow negative line_item totals if they exceed -$0.01 per invoice and flag for manual review.
2) Run exports in read-only shadow mode for 7 days to validate no regressions before turning on dedupe/seqnum enforcement.
3) Prepare backfill dry-run for 30 days and surface reconciliation report to Finance/Accounting for sign-off.
4) If net delta after authorized backfill > 1% of MRR impact, pause writes and escalate to leadership for approval.
test_plan: Unit tests for seqnum generator with permutations of ledger_id, epoch_hour_anchor, usage_bucket and concurrent leader instances.
Integration test that simulates leader failover and DST transitions (spring and fall) verifying no duplicate prorate fragments.
End-to-end staging run: shadow export for 72 hours against production-replay dataset and compare shadow -> production export diffs using exports.proration.delta metrics.
Backfill dry-run: execute backfill on a snapshot and produce reconciliation CSV; run Finance validation script and check sample invoices.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Staging deploy of deterministic seqnum + anchor derivation (complete).
Phase 1: Enable shadow exports in production for 7 days, monitor exports.proration.delta and negative_line_item alerts.
Phase 2: After shadow validation and Finance sign-off, enable dedupe/idempotent export writes for new exports only for an initial cohort of 10% tenants.
Phase 3: Gradually ramp cohort to 100% over 72 hours while monitoring net-delta and rollback on threshold breach.
Phase 4: Run authorized 30-day backfill in dry-run, present reconciliation report, then schedule write-back backfill in maintenance window with Finance present.
audit_notes: Finance will own final approval for any write-back to Stripe/NetSuite. Dry-run artifacts and reconciliation CSVs are required for approval.
Keep immutable snapshots of export manifests and ledger snapshots for every backfill run to enable rollback and auditing.
